hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: north-eastern Africa, bordering the Red Sea, between Egypt and Eritrea || generally flat, featureless plain; desert dominates the north || the Nile is Sudan's primary water source; its major tributaries, the White Nile and the Blue Nile, meet at Khartoum to form the River Nile, which flows northward through Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea || Resources: petroleum; small reserves of iron ore, copper, chromium ore, zinc, tungsten, mica, silver, gold; hydropower || Exports: crude petroleum, gold, oil seeds, sheep and goats, ground nuts (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: generally flat, featureless plain; desert dominates the north || north-eastern Africa, bordering the Red Sea, between Egypt and Eritrea

climate.excerpt: hot and dry; arid desert; rainy season varies by region (April to November) || dust storms and periodic persistent droughts

economy.excerpt: low-income Sahel economy devastated by ongoing civil war; major impacts on rural income, basic commodity prices, industrial production, agricultural supply chain, communications and commerce; hyperinflation and currency depreciation worsening food access and humanitarian conditions || Exports: crude petroleum, gold, oil seeds, sheep and goats, ground nuts (2023) || Industries: oil, cotton ginning, textiles, cement, edible oils, sugar, soap distilling, shoes, petroleum refining, pharmaceuticals, armaments, automobile/light truck assembly, milling

peopleAndCulture.from: People and Society > Languages, Religions, Ethnic groups, Urbanization
peopleAndCulture.excerpt: Sunni Muslim, small Christian minority || Sudanese Arab (approximately 70%), Fur, Beja, Nuba, Ingessana, Uduk, Fallata, Masalit, Dajo, Gimir, Tunjur, Berti; there are over 500 ethnic groups
